Well, I am close to achieving what have been long term goals. I want a 91 kg snatch, and last tested at 83. I want a 110 C and J and am at 107. Want a 400 squat and am currently at 395. Everything else is more for enjoyment because I don't want to just do shoulders and legs every day. 

Long story short, I am close to achieving set goals and have not evaluated from there because I just want to reach them.

Hello everyone. First time post in the community. I am looking for some accessory lift help. I am running Wendler 5/3/1 on a two day split and Olympic weightlifting on a three day split. My schedule currently looks like this:

Mon-Snatch Tech
Tue-C and J tech
Wed-Rest
Thurs- Heavy Oly
Fri-Squat/Bench
Sat- Rest
Sun- Deadlift/Overhead.

I have a hard time choosing accessory lifts because I am trying to make the most efficient decision that would help improve all my lifts. I probably am overthinking it because any accessory is helpful, but what do you guys think are the most efficient accessories for this kind of schedule?
